title: Risk-tiered L3 hydration budget contract (L15)
description: Per-call L3 hydration budget tiers. See ADR-027.

invariants.name: tier_enum_only
invariants.description: RiskTier value MUST be in {routine, standard, elevated, high_risk}. No other values allowed.
must: L3 query entrypoint validates the tier parameter against the enum
tier_enum is read from this contract file, not hardcoded in Python

invariants.name: budget_mapping_fixed
invariants.description: Tier-to-token mapping is fixed in this contract. Operator may override only elevated and high_risk per profile.
must: tier_budgets_tokens map matches contract values exactly at module init
routine MUST equal 0, standard MUST equal 2048 (constants across profiles)
elevated and high_risk may be reduced via profile config but defaults match contract

invariants.name: routine_skips_L3
invariants.description: When tier=routine, L3 hydration is bypassed entirely. No DB read, no card walk.
must: L3 query entrypoint short-circuits when tier=routine
caller gets L0+L1 result only
no telemetry of 'L3 attempted but found 0 cards' for routine -- it never enters L3

invariants.name: default_tier_is_standard
invariants.description: A call that does not declare a tier MUST default to 'standard' (2048), NOT 'elevated'. Prevents accidental footprint expansion.
must: missing tier arg -> 'standard'
test asserts default_tier=='standard' in this contract
L3 query entrypoint signature has tier default to RiskTier.STANDARD

invariants.name: caller_declares
invariants.description: Tier is supplied at the L3 query entrypoint via a RiskTier parameter. No automatic inference.
must: L3 query entrypoint has explicit tier parameter (positional or kw)
no runtime can change tier mid-query based on inferred signals
static grep of 'RiskTier.high_risk' MUST find every high-risk call site

invariants.name: profile_override_scope
invariants.description: Profile-level budget overrides apply ONLY to elevated and high_risk. routine=0 and standard=2048 are constants.
must: profile config schema rejects overrides for 'routine' or 'standard' keys
only 'elevated' and 'high_risk' keys are tunable per profile
profile YAML validator catches and warns on disallowed override

invariants.name: no_silent_escalation
invariants.description: Tier cannot be implicitly bumped by the runtime. Escalation requires explicit caller annotation or operator-documented exception path.
must: no code path within L3BudgetEnforcer or callers AUTO-bumps tier based on cache miss / latency / etc.
any tier change at runtime is from caller code, not framework
adaptive tier suggestion (future) is OUT of scope of this ADR

out_of_scope: Adaptive tier suggestion (explicitly NOT planned -- silent escalation forbidden by RTB-007)
Per-domain budget overrides (separate ADR if pursued)
